sloka: न मे दशरथ स्नेहात् पुत्रेण उत्पादितम् प्रियम् ।तस्य तु एवम् ब्रुवाणस्य संहतैः वानरैः सह ॥४-६३-८॥
transliteration: na me daśaratha snehāt putreṇa utpāditam priyam ।tasya tu evam bruvāṇasya saṁhataiḥ vānaraiḥ saha ॥4-63-8॥

translations.english: Even as he was telling this to the monkeys his wings started appearing in their presence.
